prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that 2025 trip—ended up spending a few days in Shenzhen, which was way more fun than I expected.
And earlier that year I did that whole Beijing to Shanghai run by train—felt like everyone I knew was doing that route in 2025.
My coworker kept talking about how they stayed at Holiday Inn Nanshan, and I remember the check-in was 2025-05-24.
They said it was booked for 3 nights, and it was under Feng Jie—apparently it all went smoothly back then.
Oh, and for that other trip, Olivia Brown was on train D321 on 2025-03-23, Second Class—someone even mentioned they had to renew_book after the fact, but it was already handled.
